title: Pembrolizumab in First-Line Treatment of Advanced-Stage Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
official: Phase II Trial of Pembrolizumab in First-Line Treatment of Advanced-Stage Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
summary: The primary objective of this trial is to estimate efficacy of the novel regimen. The primary endpoint is the 1-year PFS rate after treatment with one dose of pembrolizumab followed by four to six cycles of chemo-immunotherapy with P-BrECADD, and PET-guided radiotherapy as per standard of care
criteria:
Main Inclusion Criteria:

* age 18-60
* advanced stage classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
* no previous treatment for cHL

Main Exclusion Criteria:

* Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma or composite lymphoma
* Chemotherapy or radiotherapy in medical history
* Prior or concurrent disease that prevents treatment according to protocol
